item.title: Marlborough and Kenson jointly appointed to Newham maintenance framework
item.description: Marlborough and Kenson are due to commence work this month on a new highways maintenance framework for the London Borough of Newham, which has committed to spending up to £150m by 2032.

item.title: West Midlands Mayor plans to double pothole repair funding
item.description: Mayor Richard Parker has announced plans to double funding for pothole repairs and road resurfacing across the West Midlands, aiming to tackle what he described as the region’s ‘crumbling’ highways.

item.title: Carlisle Southern Link Road delayed by heavy rainfall
item.description: Cumberland Council’s £225m Carlisle Southern Link Road will not fully open to traffic until spring this year due to ‘higher-than-average rainfall’.

item.title: Major A46 junction upgrades given go ahead
item.description: Upgrades for the A46 Walsgrave junction as part of the £112m Coventry Junctions scheme have been granted a development consent order (DCO) by Lord Hendy, on behalf of the secretary of state for transport Heidi Alexander.

item.title: Northern Ireland launches £7m Winter Recovery Road Fund
item.description: Northern Ireland’s infrastructure minister, Liz Kimmins, has launched a £7.85m Winter Recovery Road Fund to help tackle the impact of ‘recent severe weather conditions' across the Department for Infrastructure’s (DfI) road network.

item.title: Amey launches young offender programme with DofE award
item.description: Amey has teamed up with The Duke of Edinburgh’s Award (DofE) charity to launch a new rehabilitation initiative for young offenders in England and Wales.

item.title: Arcadis appoints new director for UK and Ireland
item.description: Peter Hogg has been appointed as Arcadis' new country director for the UK and Ireland, taking the reins from Simon Bimpson, who will continue to serve as president of Arcadis Advanced Manufacturing.

item.title: NMITE adds three new trustees to board
item.description: The New Model Institute for Technology and Engineering (NMITE) has appointed three new trustees to its Board — Bill Jackson, Julian Drinkall, and Natasha Rothbucher-Thomas.

item.title: New regional civils director for Balfour Beatty
item.description: Balfour Beatty has appointed Kay Slade as managing director of its UK regional civils business.

item.title: National Highways hosts apprenticeship webinars
item.description: To mark National Apprenticeship Week, National Highways is hosting a series of webinars to spread the word about apprenticeships with the strategic road network authority.
